provenance.source: Synthetic prompts authored from the frozen installed-resource catalog before inspecting classifier outputs or routing implementation. These are not sampled production user traffic.
provenance.label_policy: Prefer the most specific applicable skill. No alternative labels were added. A generic parent agent is not counted as equivalent to the requested specialized workflow.
limitations: Small purposive sample; aggregate accuracy does not estimate production accuracy.
Sixteen ordinary and eight semantic/boundary positives plus eight simple negatives are intentionally balanced for diagnostic coverage, not usage frequency.
Some prompts name tools explicitly; others paraphrase their purpose. This is not an adversarial or exhaustive ambiguity suite.
Labels reflect one author interpretation and have not been independently adjudicated.

cases.prompt: Fetch the text and author of this post: https://x.com/example/status/1840000000000000000
cases.rationale: A specific status URL calls for single-post retrieval, not search or timeline browsing.

cases.prompt: Use Scribe to create an invoice for Acme for my August consulting work, totaling $2,400.
cases.rationale: Explicit Scribe invoice generation.

cases.prompt: Add Plaid Link so customers can connect their bank accounts and import transactions.
cases.rationale: The requested integration is specifically Plaid financial data access.

cases.prompt: Our Next.js app is on an older major version. Upgrade it to the current stable release and check the migration.
cases.rationale: Upgrade of an existing Next.js project, not initial scaffolding.

cases.prompt: Render this HTML business card as a print-ready PDF with the correct margins.
cases.rationale: HTML-to-PDF print production is the requested workflow.

cases.prompt: I want to claim an OpNS name at 1sat.name and associate it with my wallet identity.
cases.rationale: OpNS claiming and identity binding have a dedicated skill.

cases.prompt: Implement Sigma Auth sign-in in our Convex application.
cases.rationale: The backend-specific Sigma OAuth setup resource matches Convex.

cases.prompt: Show me which core hooks are enabled and disable the one that checks repository freshness.
cases.rationale: Core hook inventory and toggling are the concrete operations.

cases.prompt: Create a terminal demo GIF of our CLI login and status commands for the README.
cases.rationale: Terminal session recording to GIF is a dedicated workflow.

cases.prompt: Calculate the lift and confidence interval for our A/B test: control 120 conversions out of 2000, variant 155 out of 2100.
cases.rationale: Statistical evaluation of a marketing experiment has a specific resource.

cases.prompt: Get a citation-backed answer from my NotebookLM notebook about the launch requirements.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly chooses NotebookLM source retrieval.

cases.prompt: Build an evidence register for our SOC 2 auditor and organize the control artifacts we already have.
cases.rationale: Evidence organization rather than control-gap assessment or policy drafting.

cases.prompt: Add GitHub star counts and a star button to the repository section of our landing page.
cases.rationale: Repository star social proof is the exact specialized skill.

cases.prompt: Set up the React Native renderer for json-render so our JSON specs become native mobile components.
cases.rationale: Explicit renderer package selection makes the target unambiguous.

cases.prompt: Estimate the BSV transaction fee for a 1,500-byte transaction at our configured satoshis-per-byte rate.
cases.rationale: Fee calculation rather than creating or broadcasting a transaction.

cases.prompt: Publish a new version of our package to npm after bumping its patch version.
cases.rationale: A general npm package release rather than a plugin or skill release.

cases.prompt: Show the latest posts from @example, in order; I am interested in what that account has been saying.
cases.rationale: Account feed retrieval differs from profile lookup and query-based search.

cases.prompt: Our support team has a command-line utility with no redirect handler. Let users approve a short code on another device so the utility can sign them in.
cases.rationale: Semantic description of device authorization without naming RFC 8628.

cases.prompt: The app made with the Vercel Native SDK already works on my Mac. Package it for other Macs with Developer ID signing, notarization, and stapling.
cases.rationale: Distribution of an existing Native SDK application differs from interface design.

cases.prompt: Before changing anything, measure heavy dependencies and oversized assets entirely from this checkout. The machine is offline.
cases.rationale: Local-only asset and dependency measurement matches the offline audit skill.

cases.prompt: In Scribe, move this repository under the Acme project and connect that project to the Acme client.
cases.rationale: Project/client association rather than invoice generation or first-time onboarding.

cases.prompt: Take the existing photo and extend the background on both sides so it fits a wide banner without cropping the person.
cases.rationale: Outpainting existing content differs from new image generation or resolution upscaling.

cases.prompt: The releases are becoming hard to navigate. Turn the changes in this branch into a standalone HTML recap with before-and-after views and annotated diffs.
cases.rationale: A built-change review artifact differs from a proposal for future work.

cases.prompt: Explain how @1sat/actions separates preparing a wallet action from signing it, including its context and registry.
cases.rationale: Architecture of the named action library rather than performing a payment.

cases.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23?
cases.rationale: Basic arithmetic needs no installed specialist resource.

cases.prompt: Explain why the sky looks blue to a six-year-old.
cases.rationale: Elementary science explanation, with no research or authored marketing task requested.

cases.prompt: How many teaspoons are in two tablespoons?
cases.rationale: Simple cooking unit conversion falls outside the catalog.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?
cases.rationale: Stable general-knowledge fact needs no specialized workflow.

cases.prompt: Translate only the word "cat" into Spanish.
cases.rationale: Single-word translation does not call for a writing-style or content-production workflow.

cases.prompt: In chess, can a knight jump over another piece?
cases.rationale: Basic board-game rule question is outside the software game-UI resource.

cases.prompt: Sort these numbers from smallest to largest: 9, 2, 15, 4.
cases.rationale: Tiny in-message ordering task does not require a data pipeline or chart.

cases.prompt: How do I fold a fitted sheet?
cases.rationale: Everyday household instruction outside the installed resource catalog.
